# Jennifer's Journal

> > A Canadian author's website and blog featuring dystopian fiction, writing advice, and personal essays rooted in Newfoundland and Labrador.

Jennifer Kelland Perry is an author based in Canada who writes speculative fiction and young adult novels, including the Calmer Girls series set in 1993 Newfoundland. Her website combines author portfolio content, writing guidance for other creators, travel narratives, and personal reflections.

## Key Topics

- Jennifer Kelland Perry
- Calmer Girls Series

## Author & Works

- [About the Author](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/jenniferkellandperryauthor): Biography of Canadian author Jennifer Kelland Perry and her published works
- [Calmer Girls Series](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/calmer-girls-series): Product page for Calmer Girls YA series set in Newfoundland, 1993
- [Homepage](https://jenniferkellandperry.com): Homepage for author Jennifer Kelland Perry's website and personal blog

## Blog & Writing

- [Blog Hub](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/blog): Main blog hub featuring posts on dystopian fiction and novel announcements
- [For Writers & Bloggers](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/for-writers-bloggers): Collection of writing advice and blogging tips for authors and content creators
- [One Thing These Famous Novels Have in Common](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/2014/08/27/one-thing-these-famous-novels-have-in-common): Author advice post on debut novels and publishing success inspirations

## Travel & Local Interest

- [Newfoundland and Labrador](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/newfoundland-and-labrador-2): Curated travel guide and local interest posts about Newfoundland attractions
- [Entranced](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/2015/02/02/entranced): Travel photography post featuring architectural doors from global destinations
- [Vivian's View From Here: Kilmory Getaway](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/2015/07/12/vivians-view-from-here-kilmory-getaway): Travel diary post from pet perspective about Kilmory Resort vacation

## Optional

- [Sunday Snaps: First Snowfall (and Fun Neighbours)](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/2019/12/08/sunday-snaps-first-snowfall-fun-neighbours): Personal journal post about winter at Perry's Point with community themes
- [Overdue, but here's my Review](https://jenniferkellandperry.com/2015/01/21/2014-in-review): Annual blog review and statistics recap for 2014 with reader appreciation
